title: Casper and the Witness
author: Juniper Iversen
blurb: Ines Oyelaran, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
